made_by: kai makes, synthesized from scratch with kit/tools/make_sfx.py and make_music.py (no samples). Free to use and share.
rules: rules.md 35-39: 3 to 8 effects per short, only on big moments; accent in the first second; effects 6-12 dB over the music, under the voice.

items.use_when: a small impact or a hard cut on a fact
a crash, a fall, a big number lands
the twist or the hook reveal; pair with a riser before it
a whip move between places (8-12 frames)
an 18-frame glide or an object flying in
a fly-up to an aerial or a long camera move
sucking into a cutaway or an iris into a head
an idea, a lightbulb, a number appears
a calm reveal, a sign or a date
a button, a switch, a calendar page
a prop or character pops into the frame
something comes out or is let go (a ball from a mouth)
1.2 s before a reveal; ends on the reveal frame
the build before the twist; ends on the twist word
into a flashback or a palette change
a body or a heavy object hits the ground
one heavy footstep or a door

music.name: curious-a-minor
music.use_when: default bed: the setup and most of the story

music.name: playful-c-lydian
music.use_when: funny or light moments, character jokes

music.name: dark-c-minor
music.use_when: danger, crime, disaster (weakest match, use rarely)
